Marisa Simonetti

Independent candidate for U.S. Senator, Minnesota · Open seat

Businesswoman (Edina)

Marisa Simonetti is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Minnesota. She lives in Edina, and Eden Prairie Local News describes her as a businesswoman. She ran for Hennepin County Commissioner in District 6 in 2024 and lost to Heather Edelson, then filed on June 1, 2026 to run as an independent in the November 3 U.S. Senate election.

Where Simonetti stands

Immigration
Says ICE's immigration operation in Minnesota turned into abuse and unnecessary violence, and says the government let agents avoid accountability.
Education
Supports more funding and more staff for schools.
Small business
Supports cutting red tape for small businesses.
Housing and cost of living
Supports more affordable housing. Lists the cost of gas, groceries and high interest rates for housing among the reasons she says voters feel the system is unfair.
Criminal justice
Argues the justice system is set up to exploit people for other people's profit. She says her own criminal case made her more critical of it.
